LIFE CLOCK

Privacy policy

Updated October 10, 2026. Operator: Oleksandr Yakovenko. Contact: webvisualedmonton@gmail.com.

Your records stay on your device

The mobile app stores records, receipt photos, PDFs, notes and action history in its local database. This version has no account, cloud synchronisation, advertising or analytics SDK. LIFE does not automatically upload your records to our servers.

Permissions and reminders

Notification permission is optional. Local reminders are scheduled on your phone. Delivery and sound depend on operating system settings. Selecting a file grants the app access to that selected file. On Android you can open the system Clock to review and set an alarm separately.

Exports, links and backups

When you export a backup or calendar file, you choose its destination. Files may contain personal information. Opening a store link or sharing a file is governed by the recipient’s privacy policy. Device backups may include app data according to your Apple or Google settings. Browser and mobile storage are separate. This version does not provide a guaranteed recovery service.

Deleting data

Delete individual records or use More → Delete all data to remove app records from this installation. Copies you exported or stored in device backups must be removed separately. Uninstalling or clearing browser storage can remove local data.

Website and support

Our website is hosted by Cloudflare. Hosting infrastructure may process IP addresses and technical request information to serve and protect the website. If you email support, we receive your email address and the information you choose to send. Do not send passwords, full identity documents or payment card details. Support messages are used to respond to your request.

Changes

If future features introduce accounts, cloud storage or paid services, we will update this policy and explain any new data use.
